composition: 20 Units (5 Order / 5 Chaos / 5 Life / 5 Death) + 10 Formation Cards
template_family: Moon Demon template governs architecture/hierarchy only. Eliteborn uses its own ivory/electrum/graphite/force-glass skin with subtle Force accents.

formation_engine.formation: Play a Formation Card when you control the required Units. Add those Units' CURRENT STR together and CURRENT HP together. They become one Formation, occupy one Unit position, attack/take damage as one Unit, and receive each stat modifier once.
formation_engine.break: The Formation Card stays attached until the Formation reaches 0 HP. Then the Formation breaks; all component Units die simultaneously, then the Formation's break effect resolves unless the card says otherwise.
formation_engine.apex: Apex Formations require all five Units of one Force and combine all five into one Formation.
formation_engine.component_text: Unit cards are designed to be valuable before Formation. Any engine decision about whether component Unit text remains active while formed should be locked separately before rules implementation.
